text:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can leadership confirm concrete timelines for three things we called out: API rate-limits / quota dashboard, Console UX refresh for model routing, and Optimize's cost-recommendation beta? Need rough dates + owners so teams can plan.

Diego: Good ask. High-level: API dashboard = canary ~6w, GA ~12w. Console UX (model routing + per-route SLAs) = exploratory in 4w, canary in 10w. Optimize beta = invite-only in ~8w. Owners: Priya for API/Console infra, Kai for Optimize.

Priya: Confirming ownership for the dashboard and Console routing pieces. Plan: smoke tests in staging next Tue, canary in us-west first. Blocker: need final telemetry schema from SDKs (ping @Kai).

Kai: Noted — SDK team will cut a compatibility doc by EOD tomorrow. No breaking changes planned; we'll add opt-in flags. Example note we'll publish: "optimize_beta": true and semver bump to 0.9.0 -> 1.0.0 when GA.

Aisha: Awesome. Can we get milestone dates into the public roadmap + a short runbook for teams that rely on current quotas? Customers asked during Q&A.

Rohan: We're targeting a small public roadmap update Friday. Priorities: make the canary windows explicit and list rollback criteria. I'll host a 30m office hours this Thurs 10:30am PT to walk through the runbooks and answer product questions.

Priya: Draft rollback criteria (quick):
```
- error rate > 2x baseline for 5m
- median latency > 2x SLO for >= 10m
- cache eviction rate spike > 20% sustained
```
Will attach to the runbook.

Kai: For Optimize beta, we'll include quantization and batching knobs in the UI + CLI flag. Early customers get a report with recommended batch sizes and quant profiles.

Diego: Action items: 1) Kai publish SDK compat doc (tomorrow) 2) Priya post canary schedule + runbook (by Tue) 3) Diego to update public roadmap (Fri) 4) Rohan office hours Thurs 10:30am PT.

Aisha: Small ask — can we add a short blurb in the roadmap about whether Dedicated customers can request earlier access? That came up in the Q&A.

Priya: Yes — Dedicated customers can request priority canary access. We'll add a form link to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Canary job scheduled: `canary-api-dashboard-us-west-1` -> 2024-06-05T03:00:00Z (:rocket:)

Aisha: Thanks all. If anyone has follow-ups, drop them here or raise in office hours. I'll collect the final runbook link and post back in #all-hands summary. :white_check_mark:
